title: ViewFingerprint
description: What a derived view was rendered from (docs/design/m0/10). digest covers the renderer and the ordered identity digests of the inputs (not their content digests); internal/knowledge computes and checks it. A view is served only if its recomputed fingerprint matches. A fingerprint proves the view matches its inputs, nothing more: evidence applicability is checked separately (06).

inputs.description: Ordered: tree or candidate snapshot, receipts, findings and dispositions, the adopted contract; for review packets also the reviewer's demands and the approvals that answered them.
